title: 3D Modeling and Texturing
description:
I have experience in projects of different genres and styles, mastering 3D modeling in hard surface and soft surface. I have created characters, scenery, props, items, realistic renderings of products and architecture, as well as working with 3D printing.

I do the complete pipeline: concept, high poly, low poly, baking, texturing, skinning, rigging, animation, lighting, rendering and post-processing.

I use 3ds Max and Blender for hard surface; ZBrush for soft surface; Marmoset Toolbag, Substance Painter and Photoshop for baking and texturing; and Maya and Cascadeur for rigging and body and facial animation.
